# How to Create Video Watermark Removal with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to create a video processing task that removes a watermark from an uploaded video, including setup, request fields,…

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_watermark_removal`
- `medux_watermark_removal_by_prompt`

## Prompt

```text
Remove the watermark from the uploaded video {file id}. If the watermark area is known, use medux_watermark_removal with regions [[x, y, width, height]]; otherwise use medux_watermark_removal_by_prompt with a short description of the watermark.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input video file_id.
- `regions` (required (medux_watermark_removal)): Regions to remove, for example [[x, y, width, height]].
- `prompt_text` (required (medux_watermark_removal_by_prompt)): Text description of the watermark to remove.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
